## What lives here
The zustand stores: background runs, request ops, execution watch and notifications, chat sessions and planner history.

## Conventions
Persisted stores use the localStorage keys `background_runs`, `workflow-execution-watch`, `mistral-chat-sessions` and `agent_planner_history`. They are per browser, not per user.
